subject: Clarify dashboard seat-crediting and archival fee for observability add-ons
messages:

Subject: Clarify: dashboard seat-crediting and archival fee on proposal

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the draft proposal. We reviewed the add-ons section and had a couple of questions before we share this with procurement:

- The dashboard line item shows "seat-linked credits (30 seats)" — can you confirm how credits map to viewers vs. editors? We have 12 editors and ~80 viewers across teams.
- There is an "archival storage fee (monthly)" listed for long-term traces. Can you clarify threshold and whether there's a pilot waiver? Our legal team flagged this as an unexpected recurring cost.

If possible, can you send a short mapping table or example invoice line that shows how the first three months would be billed for our current footprint? We want to avoid surprises in procurement.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Chang
Head of Observability, AcmeOps Inc.
laura.chang@acmeops.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chang <laura.chang@acmeops.com>, Mike Rivera <mike.rivera@acmeops.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify: dashboard seat-crediting and archival fee on proposal

Hi Laura — thanks for the questions. Quick answers up front, followed by a short worked example attached.

High-level:
- Seat-crediting model: credits are applied to "active dashboard seats" (editors + viewers who actively load dashboards) on a 30-day rolling basis. We distinguish between Editor (full authoring) and Viewer (read-only). By default the proposal maps 1 credit -> 1 active viewer/editor per month.

- Two alternative crediting options we can offer:
  1) Seat-based: allocate credits to editors (recommended when viewers are mostly passive). Editors consume 1 credit/month; viewers consume 0.25 credit/month.
  2) Seatless (visual entitlement): bill per distinct dashboard visual served; useful when many viewers only see a small number of visualizations. This is priced lower per-unit but can be more variable.

- Archival fee: applies to traces retained beyond the 90-day retention included in the base addon. Archival pricing is per GiB/month for data beyond 90 days. For pilots we can waive the archival fee for the first 6 months for your account; after pilot we can tier it with a cap.

Worked example (attached spreadsheet):
- Current footprint: 12 editors, 80 viewers (estimated 22 active viewers/month).
- Option A (seat-based, default in proposal): 12 editor credits + 22 viewer credits = 34 credits/month -> matches line in proposal.
- Option B (seatless): estimated 1400 visuals served/month -> maps to ~18 credits/month under our seatless discount band.

Concession proposal for procurement (to address your concern about surprise costs):
- Pilot concession: waive archival fees for 6 months; provide a one-time 2-month credit equal to 20% of projected dashboard charges for months 1–3.

I've attached dashboard-seat-mapping.xlsx that shows per-line invoice simulation for months 1–6. If you prefer, we can convert Option B into a hybrid (editors fixed, viewers seatless) so you get predictability plus lower unit cost.

Next steps: confirm which crediting option you prefer and I will have Jordan and Ben finalize the numbers for procurement.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attachments: dashboard-seat-mapping.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: internal: suggested concession math for AcmeOps

Kim / Ben — quick internal note with suggested numbers so procurement has something concrete:

Assumptions (from spreadsheet):
- Editors: 12 -> fixed editor credits = 12 * $45 = $540/month
- Viewers (active): 22 -> viewer credits (0.25 of editor rate) = 22 * (0.25 * $45) = $247.50/month
- Seatless hybrid estimate: visuals band maps to $380/month total for dashboards
- Archival (beyond 90d): estimated 400 GiB -> $0.12/GiB/month = $48/month (waived for 6 months under pilot)

Concession proposal to offer to AcmeOps:
- Waive archival fee for first 6 months (value ~$288).
- Apply 2-month invoice credit equal to 20% of dashboard charges months 1–3 (rough initial value $220).
- In exchange, ask for a 12-month committed minimum and an acceleration clause at 12 months.

If Kimberly signs off, I can fold this into the proposal and generate a clean invoice example and DocuSign SOW.

-Jordan

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Final: dashboard crediting approach + pilot concession (next steps)

Laura / Mike — thanks for the patience while we worked the numbers. Confirming the concession and proposed next steps so procurement has what they need: 

What we're offering:
- Crediting approach: adopt the hybrid model — editors fixed, viewers seatless. This gives AcmeOps the predictability on editing capacity and lowers unit cost for heavy viewer counts. (See attached invoice example.)
- Pilot archival waiver: Redwood will waive archival storage fees for traces retained beyond 90 days for the first 6 months (value ~ $288).
- One-time credit: 2-month invoice credit equal to 20% of dashboard charges months 1–3 (applies after first invoice).

Ask from AcmeOps:
- Commit to a 12-month minimum (standard for pilot concessions).
- Approve the concession and return signed SOW/DocuSign link below so we can lock pricing and apply credits to your first invoices.

DocuSign SOW: https://www.docusign.net/someid/FAKEID12345
